title: ReviewFinding v1
description: One finding from a review pass. A finding carries a stable fingerprint (identity for the finding registry / oscillation detection) and a falsifiable claim. severity is open (blocker/note/...). Whether a blocker is admissible only with an attached red repro test is a gate rule enforced by the orchestrator, not by this schema. Forward-compatible envelope.

fingerprint.description: Stable identity of the finding (category + location + gist), used by the finding registry to count recurrences and detect oscillation.

severity.description: Finding severity. Open string; common values below.

location.description: Where the finding sits, e.g. file:line (optional; a fingerprint component).

repro_test_path.description: Path to the red test reproducing the claim (optional at the schema level; may be a gate requirement for blockers).

repro_test.description: Inline content of the repro test, when the reviewer attaches it rather than writing the file (optional).

count.description: Recurrence count for this fingerprint within the task (optional).
